00077 bool AudioFilePlayer::setFile(const File& audioFile, const int readAheadBufferSize)
00078 {
00079     stop();
00080     setSource (0);
00081     deleteAndZero (currentAudioFileSource);
00082     
00083     AudioFormatReader* reader = audioFormatReaderFromFile(audioFile);
00084     
00085     if (reader != 0)
00086     {                                       
00087         currentAudioFileSource = new AudioFormatReaderSource (reader, true);
00088         
00089         setSource (currentAudioFileSource, readAheadBufferSize, reader->sampleRate);
00090         
00091         return true;
00092     }
00093     
00094     return false;
00095 }

00102 AudioFormatReader* AudioFilePlayer::audioFormatReaderFromFile(const File& audioFile)
00103 {   
00104     AudioFormatManager formatManager;

00107     currentFile = audioFile;
